newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Daewoo unit plans retail banking expansion.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Daewoo unit plans retail banking expansion.

text.p: The Hungarian banking unit of the Korea's Daewoo Securities Co plans expansion in retail banking, bank officials said on Thursday.

"We plan to move towards retail banking and we will launch card services for individuals this year," said Daewoo Bank Rt General Director Elemer Tertak at the ground-breaking ceremony of the bank's planned new 14,700 square-meter headquarters.

The bank expects to increase its assets to 28 billion forints in 1996 from 25 billion in 1995, and it hopes three percent return on assets in 1996, compared with an after-tax profit of some 800 million forints last year, he told Reuters.

Tertak said the bank will open a new branch later this year in Debrecen, eastern Hungary, where Daewoo group DWGR.CN acquired the ball bearings firm MGM earlier this year and plans to invest $30 million in MGM over the next five years.
Tertak added Daewoo is interested in Hungarian privatisation, for example in the planned sale of the truck maker Raba Rt.
